desc.en: Fresh milk taken from livestock. It's good for many uses from drinking to cooking, but the amount harvested continues to shrink, and its market price only keeps climbing.
desc.ja: 家畜から取れた新鮮なミルク。飲用から食用まで幅広く使われるが、取れる量は減り続けており、市場価格は高騰を続けている

desc.en: Effect: Increases the effect of healing items by 10％.
desc.ja: 効果：回復アイテムの効果が１０％上昇する
